page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.4xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance running on a KVM hypervisor platform. Powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor operating at a base clock speed of 3.4 GHz, the instance equips 8 physical CPU cores providing 16 dedicated virtual CPUs through simultaneous multithreading. System memory totals 32.0 GB, establishing a 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio with 2.0 GB per core. The cache architecture incorporates 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache per core complex. Supported CPU instruction sets include AVX-512 extensions (AVX512F, VNNI, BF16), hardware-accelerated AES/VAES and SHA_NI cryptography, and vector bit manipulation flags (BMI2, ADX, FMA). The hardware profile omits local disk storage and GPU accelerators, relying on attached network storage, and provides a 12 Gbps baseline network bandwidth with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results demonstrate top-tier single-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng single-core score of 3115.19 placing it in the top 10% of tested instances and a Geekbench single-core score of 2028.0 in the top 25%. Geekbench text processing performance is also strong at 2734.0. Multi-core execution and memory subsystem throughput operate in the average benchmark range, recording 24940.13 in stress-ng multi-core tests and 12205.0 in Geekbench multi-core tests. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 49.71 GB/sec, while uncached write bandwidth measures 27.96 GB/sec. Synthetic application testing records 22.2 million Redis SET operations per second and 18.76 GB/sec static web serving throughput.

The configuration provides strong qualitative cost efficiency for single-threaded processing and vector execution tasks due to high clock speeds and AVX-512 hardware extensions. The primary trade-off is the memory constraint of 2.0 GB per vCPU and the absence of direct-attached NVMe storage, which makes IO operations dependent on network storage performance. Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.4xlarge is best suited for compute-focused workloads, such as software compilation pipelines, web server fleets, build nodes, continuous integration workers, and stateless batch data processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by a 3.4 GHz AMD EPYC 9T34 processor built on x86_64 architecture. Equipped with 8 physical cores providing 16 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of memory (2.0 GB per vCPU), it delivers a compute-oriented allocation ratio. Architectural features include AVX-512 vector extensions, hardware cryptographic acceleration, and 32 MB of L3 cache. Benchmarks highlight top-tier single-core CPU performance and strong single-thread text processing capability, alongside average multi-core execution and memory bandwidth metrics (49.71 GB/sec uncached reads). The instance includes 12 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, zero local storage, and zero integrated GPUs. Due to its dedicated compute profile and reliance on cloud block storage, the server provides strong cost efficiency for single-thread intensive applications, software compilation pipelines, web serving clusters, and stateless batch processing tasks.
